title: Attention and concentration
learning_outcomes: Explain attention limits in the context of attention and concentration.
Compare and distinguish interruptions in the context of attention and concentration.
Apply protected practice in the context of attention and concentration.
Evaluate and justify decisions about rest in the context of attention and concentration.

lessons.title: Attention limits
lessons.outcome: Explain attention limits in the context of attention and concentration.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving attention limits; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to attention audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain attention limits from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of attention limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Interruptions
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish interruptions in the context of attention and concentration.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving interruptions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to attention audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain interruptions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of interruptions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Protected practice
lessons.outcome: Apply protected practice in the context of attention and concentration.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving protected practice; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to attention audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain protected practice from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of protected practice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Rest
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about rest in the context of attention and concentration.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving rest; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to attention audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain rest from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of rest; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of attention limits; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of interruptions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of protected practice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of rest; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
